content.note: computed before eval_spec.json / d3_spec.json freeze; no held-out outcome and no D3 association read

R1.reading_test_expectation: constraint and xc_excess event-study power about 0.52 / 0.49: SIGN-CONSISTENT is the likely ceiling of the R1-8 reading test

D3.rule: first of L1..L4 with >= 80 screen MAIN concepts having both X and Y

decision.consequence: sentence dropped; the paper reports two separate findings

disclosures: exposure is an early-life window (ages 3-5), not literally pre-onset; S2 gives the literal pre-onset version on the screen
cross-sectional across concepts: supports an association, not a mechanism
held-out early volume (F..F+5) reads dataset_5 link counts that may extend past 2015 for late-F concepts; it is a single per-concept mean, no E_up label is computed here
Y3 (exported mean) has no timing restriction and overlaps the exposure window
population is arXiv-skewed (physics/CS); S5 reports the non-physics subset

verdict_detail.cell: MAIN x all x E_up x route all
verdict_detail.rule_text: BROKERAGE if ALL of: S_res < 0 and CI_res excludes 0; |S_res| >= 0.5*|S_raw|; S(closure_persist) < 0; S(constraint) < 0; (CI(closure_persist) excludes 0 OR CI(constraint) excludes 0). TURNOVER if ALL of: CI_res includes 0; |S_res| < 0.5*|S_raw|; R1b null (CI(closure_persist) includes 0). MIXED otherwise. R1b NON-ESTIMABLE (< 10 matched treated with finite closure_persist in k=-3..0) counts as null for TURNOVER and as failing for BROKERAGE. S_raw = S(closure), S_res = S(closure_resT), cell = MAIN x all x E_up x route all. Flags never change the label: R1c_degree_driven, R1b_selection, H_sensitive, underpowered, fresh_replication, route_B_only agreement, R1a_model_dependent.
verdict_detail.label_disclosure: E_up is a POST-HOC primary label (promoted in iteration 2); confirmation only via the iteration-4 sealed held-out fold.

content.note: one run only; no subgroup search (spec decision rules)

content.source: results/r1/r1_capture_raw.pkl (recorder of the single held-out run)

content.status: descriptive only (D1 not supported on screen)

decision_rules.CONFIRMED: Holm-adjusted (over the 4 rows closure_resT, closure_persist, constraint, raw closure) one-sided p < 0.05 in the declared direction, with the row's primary estimator
decision_rules.DEAD: otherwise; no subgroup search, no new rows, no relabelling
decision_rules.verdict: the BROKERAGE / TURNOVER / MIXED rule is applied again on the held-out event study
decision_rules.verdict_rule_text: BROKERAGE if ALL of: S_res < 0 and CI_res excludes 0; |S_res| >= 0.5*|S_raw|; S(closure_persist) < 0; S(constraint) < 0; (CI(closure_persist) excludes 0 OR CI(constraint) excludes 0). TURNOVER if ALL of: CI_res includes 0; |S_res| < 0.5*|S_raw|; R1b null (CI(closure_persist) includes 0). MIXED otherwise. R1b NON-ESTIMABLE (< 10 matched treated with finite closure_persist in k=-3..0) counts as null for TURNOVER and as failing for BROKERAGE. S_raw = S(closure), S_res = S(closure_resT), cell = MAIN x all x E_up x route all. Flags never change the label: R1c_degree_driven, R1b_selection, H_sensitive, underpowered, fresh_replication, route_B_only agreement, R1a_model_dependent.

content.direction_note: directions are the pre-registered SPEC3 (brokerage-hypothesis) directions frozen in prereg_v3.json before labels; a row whose screen S has the opposite sign is still tested in the declared direction.
content.entry_point: uv run confirm_heldout.py --spec heldout_spec.json --expected-sha256 <sha256 in heldout_spec.sha256>

estimands.S_definition: mean over k in [-3, 0] of the per-k mean (treated - mean of matched controls); k = 0 is the onset focal year t0 whose features use data <= t0
estimands.label_E_up: E_up(c,t) = 1 iff mean all-type c-papers/yr over t+1..t+5 >= 20 AND vol(t+5) >= 0.7*vol(t+1); t in F+3..F+8, t <= 2019, t not in 2016-18; onset t0 = first t in 2008-2015 with E_up = 1; never = eligible concept with no onset (vendored analysis_event.build_labels/assign_groups)

estimator_definitions.event_study: vendored matching + es_matrix; event3.es_boot (B below, seed = stable_seed(row, 'MAIN|all|E_up|all', 20261001)); one-sided p = share of bootstrap S on the wrong side
estimator_definitions.pooled_panel: OLS row ~ futE + log_vol3 + age + year FE on held-out MAIN emerging+never concept-years (age >= 0, 2005-2015, post-onset years dropped); CR1 concept-cluster SE; one-sided normal p

content.estimator_rule: smaller MDE (80% power, one-sided alpha 0.05); ties within 5% -> event study
content.heldout_fallback_rule: if fewer than 20 matched treated, controls may also come from the screen MAIN never set

sealed_pass.note: W1 features of the 119 held-out main-arm concepts computed with the frozen code; percentiles are insertion ranks against the active distribution; betweenness from a separate graph; residualisation uses SCREEN betas (never refit on held-out)

content.title: Held-out confirmation spec: is pre-take-off openness brokerage or churn? (RQ1, iteration 3 -> 4)

content.artifact: RQ2-D1 screen test (openness -> W2 disciplinary breadth gain)
content.unit_rows: held-out MAIN concepts (fold heldout_concept, in_MAIN), t in [F+3, F+8], t <= 2015; W1 = [t-5, t], W2 = [t+1, t+5]

estimands.note: D1 not supported on screen; held-out estimates are descriptive only, no confirmation claim

estimator.formula: Y ~ 1 + openness_z + H_W1 + n_active_W1 + log_vol_W1 + momentum + GEB + burst_state + rafols_coh_f + coh_missing + P_rar_f + P_rar_missing + C(origin_group) + C(F_band) + C(route) + C(t)
estimator.dummy_levels: frozen screen levels (unknown held-out levels -> reference level)
estimator.closure_res: closure - X b with the frozen screen R1a coefficients (results/openness/r1a_fit.json)

content.decision_rule: one-sided: coef(openness_z) < 0 with the 95% cluster-bootstrap CI excluding 0 AND Holm across the carried outcomes (p_boot, two-sided bootstrap p) < 0.05; secondary: transfer delta-R2 = FULL vs BASE fitted on the SCREEN MAIN rows, evaluated on the held-out rows, concept-bootstrap (2000) CI lower bound > 0. With co-primary closure_res_imp (F3), both measures must meet the rule.
content.no_re_screen_clause: Iteration 4 runs confirm_heldout.py once, unchanged. No re-screening, no new outcomes, no new covariates and no re-tuning on held-out data; any deviation is reported as exploratory.
